subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu: send text + multiple images as a single interactive card

question: Should Feishu text or presentation plus image attachments automatically collapse into one interactive image card, or should senders opt in with an explicit Feishu-scoped option?
rationale: The code boundary is clear, but changing the default send shape affects existing Feishu message semantics and the safety policy for card images needs owner intent before automation can implement it.

options.title: Opt-in image cards
options.body: Add a Feishu-scoped opt-in first so existing text-plus-media sends keep sequential behavior unless the sender requests a card.

options.title: Automatic image cards
options.body: Automatically compose one card whenever Feishu sends include text or presentation plus image attachments, with sequential fallback on upload or card failure.

options.title: Wait for generic presentation images
options.body: Defer the feature until the cross-channel presentation contract grows an image block instead of adding a Feishu-first option.

recommendation.title: Opt-in image cards
recommendation.body: Add a Feishu-scoped opt-in first so existing text-plus-media sends keep sequential behavior unless the sender requests a card.

likelyOwner.reason: m1heng is the declared Feishu plugin community owner and was mentioned on this issue, making them the best available product-direction owner for Feishu-specific send semantics.
